tbesh_html:
1) to rise, come forth, break out, arise, rise up, shine
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to rise
1a2) to come out, appear

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to irradiate (or shoot forth beams), i.e. to rise (as the sun); specifically, to appear (as a symptom of leprosy)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: arise, rise (up), as soon as it is up.
